units.source_text: 其實，我自己一個人坐電車時害怕列車長；

en.t: In fact, when I rode the train alone, I was afraid of the conductor.

units.source_text: 想進歌舞伎劇場時，看到大門口鋪著紅地毯的樓梯兩側站著引座的小姐，我便望而卻步；

en.t: Even when I wanted to enter a kabuki theater, the sight of the ushering young women standing on both sides of the red-carpeted stairs at the main entrance made me draw back.

units.source_text: 進入餐館時，悄悄站在我背後，等著收拾碗碟的服務員也讓我發怵；

en.t: When I entered a restaurant, the waiter standing quietly behind me, waiting to clear the dishes, also frightened me.
Especially when paying for purchases, ah!

units.source_text: 自己僵硬笨拙的手勢並非出於吝嗇，而是由於我的過度緊張、害臊、不安和恐懼，

en.t: My stiff, awkward gestures were not due to stinginess, but to my excessive tension, embarrassment, anxiety, and fear.

units.source_text: 覺得頭暈目眩，眼前的世界一片黑暗，真的是要陷入精神錯亂的狀態，

en.t: I would feel dizzy, the world before my eyes would go completely dark, and I truly seemed about to fall into a state of mental derangement.

units.source_text: 別說討價還價了，甚至連買的東西和找的零錢都忘記拿。

en.t: Far from bargaining, I would even forget to take the things I had bought and the change I was due.
